opis: The cosy kitchen from the reference picture (the same wallpaper, window, wall clock, shelves, mint cupboard and big wooden table), warm evening light, the window dark blue with a few stars. Around the table sit five guests: the OWL and her FOUR small fluffy grey-brown OWLETS (baby owls with big round eyes), each one on its own chair or cushion. In front of each guest ONE white plate with a blue rim and ONE blue cup on it - five plates and five cups in all, one for each guest. The BEAR, in a white baker's apron, carries a big basket of golden bread rolls to the table and smiles; the SQUIRREL pours tea from a teapot and the small HEDGEHOG hands an owlet a roll. Everybody is happy, warm and festive, a little paper garland over the window.
